styles.label: Sections
styles.blurb: Warm paper, white stat cards, one accent per card.
styles.best_for: The default. Any topic, any audience — reads like NotebookLM's own output.

styles.label: Editorial
styles.blurb: White page, oversized numerals, hairline rules, one accent.
styles.best_for: Numbers that carry the story: results, milestones, before/after.

styles.label: Poster
styles.blurb: Dark indigo gradient, one accent, facts in a strip.
styles.best_for: A launch, an announcement, a single idea that should feel like a cover.

styles.label: Swiss Grid
styles.blurb: Helvetica discipline: strict columns, black type, red rule.
styles.best_for: Comparisons, methodology, anything that should look unarguable.

styles.label: Magazine
styles.blurb: Warm cream, serif headlines, brown accents, wide margins.
styles.best_for: Culture, history, interviews — long-read material that needs to feel edited.

styles.label: Bento
styles.blurb: Mosaic of rounded tiles on cool paper, blue-led accents.
styles.best_for: A roundup: five or six parallel facts that each deserve their own box.

styles.label: Blueprint
styles.blurb: Deep navy grid, white hairlines, monospace labels.
styles.best_for: Engineering, architecture, systems, anything with a spec and a tolerance.

styles.label: Terminal
styles.blurb: Near-black, phosphor blue, monospace, prompt rules.
styles.best_for: Developer tools, incident write-ups, logs and throughput numbers.

styles.label: Neon
styles.blurb: Black-violet field with glowing magenta and cyan accents.
styles.best_for: AI, gaming, nightlife, a launch that wants to feel loud and new.

styles.label: Brutalist
styles.blurb: Hard black borders, no radius, acid-yellow highlight.
styles.best_for: Manifestos, takes, pricing pages — content with an attitude.

styles.label: Retro Print
styles.blurb: Cream stock, halftone dots, warm 70s palette.
styles.best_for: History, music, sport, anything with a nostalgic streak.

styles.label: Risograph
styles.blurb: Two-ink overprint on cream, deliberately off-register.
styles.best_for: Zines, research roundups, a poster that should look screen-printed.

styles.label: Kraft
styles.blurb: Taped paper cards on kraft stock, brown ink, soft serif.
styles.best_for: Field notes, workshops, a handmade brief pinned to a board.

styles.label: Chalkboard
styles.blurb: Slate green board, chalk white, wobbly hand rules.
styles.best_for: Teaching, a lecture summary, a study poster for a classroom.

styles.label: Dashboard
styles.blurb: Cool grey-white KPI tiles with bar meters and deltas.
styles.best_for: Metrics, benchmarks, a status readout where the numbers are the point.

styles.label: Mission Control
styles.blurb: Dark console: blue, amber and green telemetry tiles.
styles.best_for: Ops, infrastructure, a fleet or a system under load.

styles.label: Cartoon
styles.blurb: Thick outlines, flat fills, friendly shapes and a picture-book sky.
styles.best_for: Explainers, classroom material, anything for a non-specialist audience.

styles.label: Realistic
styles.blurb: Deep neutrals, layered light, soft shadow and film grain.
styles.best_for: Reports, product paint, anything that should look photographed rather than drawn.

styles.label: Newspaper
styles.blurb: Salmon stock, serif headline, black rules, one deep red.
styles.best_for: Investigations, policy, anything that should read like it went to press.

styles.label: Annual Report
styles.blurb: White grid, navy and gold, small caps, footnoted calm.
styles.best_for: Board material, year-in-review, anything that must look audited.

styles.label: Museum
styles.blurb: Gallery label: hairline rules, tiny caps, enormous margins.
styles.best_for: Objects, places, one idea given room — where restraint is the point.

styles.label: Film Poster
styles.blurb: Condensed caps on black, one red accent, a single spotlight.
styles.best_for: A launch, a screening, a story with a poster instead of a page.

styles.label: Data Desk
styles.blurb: White sheet, annotation red, tick marks, chart discipline.
styles.best_for: Investigations with numbers, benchmarks, a story told by a chart.

styles.label: Art Deco
styles.blurb: Black and gold: framed, rayed, symmetrical, theatrical.
styles.best_for: Anniversaries, galas, premium covers — when it should feel engraved.

styles.label: Glass
styles.blurb: Mesh gradient behind frosted panels — modern product light.
styles.best_for: Product, AI, SaaS launches; a screenshot that looks like an app.

styles.label: Clay
styles.blurb: Soft matte tiles with real shadows — tactile, not flat.
styles.best_for: Friendly product explainers, onboarding, anything meant to feel touchable.

styles.label: Ink Wash
styles.blurb: Rice paper, two brush strokes, vermilion seal, serif.
styles.best_for: Philosophy, craft, history — material that benefits from silence.

styles.label: HUD
styles.blurb: Phosphor green on black glass, reticle grid, corner brackets.
styles.best_for: Systems, telemetry, mission status — data read at a glance.

styles.label: Dithered
styles.blurb: Sepia stock, dot screen, halftone band — a two-colour print.
styles.best_for: Zines, retro tech, anything that should look printed on an old machine.

styles.label: Tabloid
styles.blurb: Black, neon pink, yellow — a technology cover that shouts.
styles.best_for: Reviews, launches, opinion — where the cover is the argument.

styles.label: Carbon
styles.blurb: IBM structure: white sheet, 1px grid, one blue, mono labels.
styles.best_for: Enterprise, engineering, process documentation that must look exact.

styles.label: Arc
styles.blurb: Warm pastel mesh behind soft white panels — friendly and modern.
styles.best_for: Product explainers, onboarding, anything that should feel inviting.

styles.label: Aerospace
styles.blurb: Black, hairline, mono specs — a mission sheet that says nothing extra.
styles.best_for: Hardware, spacecraft, launch sequences, industrial previews.

styles.label: Butter
styles.blurb: Warm cream stock, cobalt numerals, butter-yellow highlight.
styles.best_for: Bright explainers, product tours, anything with a friendly, sure tone.

styles.label: Matcha
styles.blurb: Pale green paper, deep olive type, clay and teal accents.
styles.best_for: Sustainability, food, slow research, calm evidence.

styles.label: Gothic
styles.blurb: Charcoal stone, muted jewel accents, serif, hairline rules.
styles.best_for: Archives, history, literature — a page that reads as printed and old.

styles.label: Y2K
styles.blurb: Cream page, hyper-saturated cyan, pink and lime, glossy radii.
styles.best_for: Launches, drops, culture — loud, optimistic, unmistakably now.

styles.label: Stone
styles.blurb: Warm grey sheet, muted clay and sage, mono labels, no radius.
styles.best_for: Field reports, specs, quiet technical notes that still look designed.
